name: gt_last_band
caption: Last-band G_t (integer turnover band covering 12W) for every S11 cell × embedding that produced a persistence run. CI is seed-cluster bootstrap (ADR-0025). Lock counts use F1 + N_confirm=3.
alt_text: Last-band G_t (integer turnover band covering 12W) for every S11 cell × embedding that produced a persistence run. CI is seed-cluster bootstrap (ADR-0025). Lock counts use F1 + N_confirm=3.
limitations: A positive last-band G_t is seed-conditioned ensemble persistence in that representation, not semantic-domain memory and not an absorbing lock. A CI that includes 0 is not established. Unidentified last-band (0 between pairs or non-finite G) is not a sign flip. Do not pool with S9 Qwen or S10 OLMo. Empty-completion FAILED trajectories are absent from G_t.
